## Source: amazon-inspector (bc8005889d1341b2a59a879ac055990fc071ea11c67093f04f88ebf15caeb90e)
The package hookgantry 0.1.0 was scanned and no indicators of installer-side harm were found. There is no evidence of install-time or import-time network activity, no credential or environment harvesting, no fetch-and-execute dropper, no silent relay of caller data, and no persistence mechanism.

## Source: kam193 (8f2adef4202c047248aedfecfea60e5c71798b9a9f15999a7f9c76e6a5471dab)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
